Comment: Signs in the local account 'kiosk' automatically at every start. WARNING: Windows keeps DefaultPassword in plain text in the registry, readable by every administrator of this PC. Only use it for a kiosk account without other rights, and keep this file and its answers protected. The account itself is created in UserAccounts.

RegistryKeys.Comment: For a local account, the name of this computer.
RegistryKeys.Name: DefaultDomainName
RegistryKeys.Value: {{input:Computer name of this PC, for the local kiosk account}}

RegistryKeys.Comment: Asked for during the restore, but stored in plain text in the registry.
RegistryKeys.Name: DefaultPassword
RegistryKeys.Value: {{password:Password of the kiosk account, stored in plain text for auto logon}}

RegistryKeys.Comment: Without a count, auto logon keeps working after the first sign-in.
RegistryKeys.Name: AutoLogonCount

RegistryKeys.Comment: 0 turns off 'Require Windows Hello sign-in for Microsoft accounts', which hides auto logon on Windows 10 and 11.
RegistryKeys.Name: DevicePasswordLessBuildVersion
